P.name: Darkness Rise
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Mordekaiser's''' basic attacks are empowered to deal {{as|40% AP}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Mordekaiser''' generates a {{tip|stack}} for each enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} damaged by his {{tip|basic attacks}} or hit by his basic {{tip|abilities}}, lasting for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, he gains ''Darkness Rise''.
P.description3: {{sbc|Darkness Rise:}} '''Mordekaiser''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pplevel|3 to 18|1;6;11;19;24;30|key=%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and deals{{ft|{{as|5|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{pplevel|key=%|1 to 5}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|magic damage}} every second|{{as|{{ap|5*0.125}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.125}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{pplevel|key=%|1*0.125 to 5*0.125}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.125}} seconds}}to nearby enemies. Against monsters, the damage is capped at{{ft|{{pplevel|40 to 200}} per second.|{{pp|40*0.125 to 200*0.125}} per {{fd|0.125}} seconds.}}

Q.name: Obliterate
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mordekaiser''' strikes his mace down in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within, {{ccs|increased|magic}} if only one enemy is hit.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{pp|0 + (45-0)/9*(x-1) for 12|1;10 to 20|formula=0 at level 1, then +5 every level starting at level 10}} (+ {{ap|80 to 220}}) {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Isolated Damage Increase|{{ap|{{#expr:(1.3-1)*100}} to {{#expr:(1.5-1)*100}}}}%}}

W.name: Indestructible
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Mordekaiser''' stores {{fd|45}}% of the {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} damage he deals and {{fd|7.5}}% of the {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} damage he takes,{{ft|reduced by {{ap|(1-0.25)*100}}% for non-champion sources,|reduced to {{ap|45*0.25}}% of damage dealt and {{ap|7.5*0.25}}% of damage taken for non-champion sources,}}as ''Potential Shield'' on his secondary resource bar, up to {{sti|health|{{as|{{fd|30}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}}}. The ''Potential Shield'' decays by {{pp|8 to 25}} every second after not dealing or taking damage for 1 second. While ''Indestructible'' is not on cooldown, the ''Potential Shield'' will not decay below a minimum of {{as|{{fd|5}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}, and it will be set to that amount when it comes off cooldown if it was previously below it.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mordekaiser''' consumes his ''Potential Shield'' to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} for the same amount for 4 seconds. The shield decays exponentially over the duration. ''Indestructible'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the shield is active.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Mordekaiser''' consumes the remaining shield, {{tip|healing}} for a portion of the amount.

E.name: Death's Grasp
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mordekaiser''' summons a claw in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} of the area. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds, it deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them over 250 units.

R.name: Realm of Death
R.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Mordekaiser''' aims his mace towards the target enemy champion, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 75% and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them over the cast time, and then [[File:Mordekaiser Realm of Death banished icon.png|20px|link=]] {{tt|banishing|See notes}} them with him to the ''Death Realm'' for 7 seconds.

'''Mordekaiser''' also consumes the target's soul for 7 seconds, {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for {{as|10% of their '''maximum''' health}} and reducing their '''current''' {{sti|{{as|ability power}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''total''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''maximum''' health}}}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|magic resistance}}}}, and {{tip|size}} by 10% for the duration. Additionally, the target's {{sti|{{as|'''base''' attack damage}}}} is reduced by {{as|10% of their '''current total''' AD}} for the same duration. '''Mordekaiser''' gains the reduced stats of the target for himself for the same duration, and if the target dies while inside the ''Death Realm'', he keeps their partial stats until they [[death|respawn]].
R.description3: Units between realms see each other as spirits, considering each other dead and negating any {{tt|interactions|See notes}} between each other. Only '''Mordekaiser''' and the target will enter the realm; other champions cannot follow them. Everything that occurs inside the ''Death Realm'' is hidden to units outside of it, and vice versa. {{tt|Most|See notes for exceptions}} {{tip|pets}} still inside the realm are killed at its end.
R.description4: ''When the Realm of Death ends, all affected champions are returned to the normal realm. The Realm of Death ends prematurely if either affected champion dies or is {{tt|forced out of the realm|See Map-Specific Differences}}.''
